decisions.reason: The DPA management software has its own page and positive customer feedback, and it fits the firm's announced compliance and agency focus, so management has strong reasons to keep investing in it.
The management platform is featured on the home page as a core, heavily invested part of the agency-platform strategy, making it highly visible and central to the firm's direction.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business and still has its own page, so it remains a committed part of the offering.
Extended PHP security support is only mentioned and is tied to aging PHP versions, but it supports the security promise and costs little to keep, so management will likely retain it for now.
